Markets.title: Sebi proposes limiting tenure of chief executives, independent directors at exchanges
Markets.summary: India's Securities and Exchange Board has proposed limiting managing director tenures at market exchanges to eight years. The regulator also suggested lowering the maximum age for public interest directors to 70 and capping their service at two three-year terms.

Markets.title: Nasdaq tumbles 2% as Anthropic retreat deepens AI trade concerns
Markets.summary: Anthropic's falling stock price caused the Nasdaq Composite index to drop 2% amid growing investor skepticism toward the AI sector. Persistent anxiety over potential Federal Reserve interest rate hikes also put pressure on major U.S. stock indexes.

Markets.title: Nasdaq crashes 5% at close, erasing 2026 gains; S&P 500, Dow in correction: Stock Market Highlights
Markets.summary: The Nasdaq crashed 5% at the close, erasing all of its gains for 2026. Meanwhile, both the S&P 500 and the Dow entered correction territory during the market selloff.

Markets.title: Rupee climbs past 93/USD as investors seek shelter in Indian stocks, shorts unwind
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee strengthened past the 93-per-dollar level for the first time since April, driven by over $12 billion in foreign equity investments during November. Hedge funds unwound bearish positions and the Reserve Bank of India implemented stabilization measures, further supporting the currency's recovery.

Markets.title: Anthropic's debut rally fades as shares crack 7% in US pre-market trade
Markets.summary: Anthropic shares dropped up to 7.4% in premarket trading on their second day following a record-setting IPO debut. A global market selloff, steep valuation, and competitive threats contributed to the decline.

Markets.title: Sharp rupee appreciation may cut IT firms' FY27 earnings by up to 13%: Report
Markets.summary: A new report warns that a stronger Indian rupee could reduce Indian IT firms' FY27 earnings by up to 13 percent. This appreciation will significantly impact profitability, particularly for companies with high European exposure.

Geo-Political.title: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham
Geo-Political.summary: Following a recent agreement on food exports, emissions trading, and youth mobility, the UK and EU are planning to pursue even closer ties. Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham confirmed the UK's intention to explore this deeper relationship.

Geo-Political.title: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper
Geo-Political.summary: Denmark accused Russia of plotting to assassinate a US-Ukrainian rapper. Although the Russian embassy denied the allegation, Denmark expelled Russia's defense attaché in response.

Geo-Political.title: French police officers sentenced for beating of music producer Michel Zecler
Geo-Political.summary: A French court sentenced several police officers for the 2020 beating of Black music producer Michel Zecler. The court ruled that the attack constituted an aggravated circumstance of racism.

Geo-Political.title: Gérard Depardieu and French author investigated over sexual allegations
Geo-Political.summary: French authorities launched a judicial investigation following a complaint filed last year. The investigation involves actor Gérard Depardieu and a French author over allegations of a sexual nature.

Geo-Political.title: Russian missile hits Poland as Ukraine's allies hold military exercise, says Tusk
Geo-Political.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk reported that a Russian missile entered Polish airspace during military exercises held by Ukraine's allies. Warsaw labeled the incident a Russian provocation, though no injuries or damages occurred.

Geo-Political.title: Russia targets Kyiv crossings days after Ukraine hits Crimean Bridge
Geo-Political.summary: Russia launched a massive air attack targeting crossings in Kyiv just days after Ukraine struck the Crimean Bridge. Simultaneously, Moscow rejected the prospect of international security guarantees for Ukraine.

AI & Tech.title: REA: The Open-Source AI Tool That Can Reverse Engineer Almost Anything (2026 Guide)
AI & Tech.summary: REA is a new open-source AI tool that allows users to understand how applications and games work without needing to read the source code. The tool eliminates the need for months of learning disassemblers and assembly code by providing evidence-backed answers about app mechanics.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author tested getting organic traffic from ChatGPT and found their WordPress SaaS course recommended as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates how AI optimization (AIO) is changing traditional search engine optimization (SEO) for content creators.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape in 2025 requires content creators to use artificial intelligence to stay competitive. This guide highlights the top 10 AI tools designed to simplify and revolutionize the content creation process.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is an AI platform that allows users to generate content using artificial intelligence. The platform also provides creators with tools to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools of 2023 used across various industries to drive innovation. These advanced technologies are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase overall productivity.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This article reviews the top ten artificial intelligence content generator tools available in 2022. It aims to help readers choose the most effective and efficient AI writer for their audience and needs.

Data & Insights.title: Undisclosed foreign assets? Taxpayers can declare multiple holdings for  ₹1 lakh
Data & Insights.summary: Taxpayers with undisclosed foreign assets up to ₹5 crore can declare multiple holdings under the FAST-DS scheme. The Central Board of Direct Taxes clarified this option is available for a fee of ₹1 lakh in newly released FAQs.

Data & Insights.title: RBI eases export paperwork for individuals, sets cap for service exporters
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has simplified export paperwork for individuals. It also established a specific payment cap for service exporters to help banks process overseas transactions more clearly.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Look into wage stagnation’: DEA Secy Anuradha Thakur calls on India Inc to improve employee pay – here’s what she said
Data & Insights.summary: Economic Affairs Secretary Anuradha Thakur urged Indian businesses to address stagnant employee wages. She stated that better compensation would boost consumer spending and support economic growth.

Data & Insights.title: Govt weighing ways to boost long-term credit to manufacturing: DEA secretary Anuradha Thakur
Data & Insights.summary: The Department of Economic Affairs Secretary Anuradha Thakur stated that the government is exploring measures to increase long-term credit for the manufacturing sector. She also urged large corporations to engage in public-private partnerships, collaborate with smaller enterprises, and tackle wage stagnation.

Data & Insights.title: More economic red signals in October—but not everywhere, shows Mint tracker
Data & Insights.summary: The Mint tracker shows rising economic warning signals across India in October, though producer and industrial segments remain stable. However, the second half of the year is expected to be more difficult as the positive effects of previous GST rate cuts and lower interest rates diminish.

Data & Insights.title: UK inflation hits one-year high of 3.6%: Why are markets less convinced of another rate hike? | Explained
Data & Insights.summary: UK inflation rose to a one-year high of 3.6% in October due to increased fuel prices and tobacco taxes. Despite this increase, steady core and services inflation reduced market expectations for a December Bank of England rate hike.

India.title: India Says It Backed Speedy Rohingya Return After UN Court Verdict
India.summary: Following an International Court of Justice ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, India stated it supports their speedy return. The UN court determined that Myanmar violated its obligations under the Genocide Convention during 2017 operations in Rakhine state.

India.title: 'Hours In Punjab, No Time For Haryana': Deputy Dushyant Chautala Slams Nayab Saini
India.summary: Haryana Deputy Chief Minister Dushyant Chautala criticized Chief Minister Nayab Saini for neglecting state issues while aiming to form a BJP government in Punjab. Chautala claimed that Saini spends hours campaigning in Punjab instead of focusing on problems within Haryana.

India.title: Investment Secrets Leaked To Andhra? Tamil Nadu Agency Breaks Silence
India.summary: Guidance Tamil Nadu stated that recent employee departures are a normal organizational phenomenon driven by personal and professional reasons. The agency made this statement in response to concerns that investment secrets were leaked to Andhra Pradesh.

India.title: Madras High Court Asks Why Airport Project Dropped After Rs 680 Crore Expense
India.summary: The Madras High Court questioned why authorities abandoned an airport project after spending 680 crore rupees. The court noted that the project had already secured approvals and made significant progress in land acquisition.

India.title: Akhilesh Yadav Says His Supporters Being Harassed Over Boy's Death In Bulldozer Mishap
India.summary: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav has claimed that police are harassing his supporters following the death of a boy in a bulldozer accident. This statement follows the police arrest of five individuals in connection with the fatal incident.

India.title: Stubble Smoke Causes Fatal Crash In Punjab's Doraha, Woman Dies, 3 Injured
India.summary: Thick smoke from stubble burning reduced road visibility and caused a fatal vehicle crash in Doraha, Punjab. One woman died in the accident, and three other people sustained injuries.

General.title: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham
General.summary: The UK and the EU agreed to a new deal on Friday covering food exports, emissions trading, and a youth experience scheme. Following this agreement, Andy Burnham stated that the UK will explore even closer ties with the EU.

General.title: Faisal Islam: This cost-cutting UK-EU deal doesn't mean lower prices will follow
General.summary: A new UK-EU cost-cutting trade deal is expected to boost the economy more than previous post-Brexit agreements. However, the agreement is unlikely to result in lower food prices for shoppers.

General.title: Russian missile hits Poland as Kyiv's allies hold military exercise, says Tusk
General.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk stated that a Russian missile entered Polish airspace during military exercises held by Kyiv's allies. Although Warsaw condemned the event as a Russian provocation, no injuries or damage were reported.

General.title: What we know about the latest Russian missile strikes on Ukraine
General.summary: Russia launched a major attack using missiles against Ukraine. The strikes hit bridges and railway stations in the capital city of Kyiv.

General.title: Man guilty of murdering woman he groomed on fetish site
General.summary: Dwain Hall was convicted of kidnapping and first-degree murder in the death of Sonia Exelby. The two had previously met on a fetish website where Hall groomed her.

General.title: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide
General.summary: Pressures weighed on US markets, with the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average pushed into correction territory.
